traditional: A 同 B 有共鳴
jyutping: A tung4 B jau5 gung6 ming4

english.note: Use this when someone emotionally or intellectually identifies with another person, character, or experience.

examples.english: I really relate to this character.
examples.traditional: 我同呢個角色好有共鳴。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 hou2 jau5 gung6 ming4
